coordinates.origin: top-left pixel center of individual frame
coordinates.mirrorX: Reflect the complete body/prop/grip composite: destination.x = frameWidth - 1 - destination.x. Hand x mirrors the same way; axis angle becomes (180 - angle + 360) % 360. Do not also apply a second prop reflection.
coordinates.propTransform: destination = hand + scale * R(angle - axisAngle) * (sourcePixel - pivot)
coordinates.layer: front: body then prop then grip (grip restores fingers over the handle); back: prop then body

anchorNotes.staff_atk: Final hand pixels visually remeasured on the existing empty-hand sheet; supersedes source/hand-corrections.json. Frame 2 old [39,20] is transparent; final [32,23].

bodyArtCorrection.scope: Four body sheets, six frames; 100 listed weapon-remnant pixels cleared; 5 string pixels over the bow_atk frame 5 sleeve replaced with adjacent sleeve colors. Hand/arm/body shape and grip overlays preserved.
